It happens when the TS returns retry-able CQL return code to the driver, so the driver repeat the request again and again. To fix this - TS must return another (non retry-able) CQL error code. 

Similar issues:
https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/2116
https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/2737

The same as in the issue https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/2116

Root cause: the error code mapping: Status::RuntimeError -> ErrorCode::INVALID_ARGUMENTS -> ErrorCode::STALE_METADATA -> Code::UNPREPARED (YCQL error code). UNPREPARED code is retryable in the driver.
(In case of Python driver the retry loop is endless, so the user will never get the error message.)

Fix: the fixed error code mapping is: (value too long) Status::NotSupported -> ErrorCode::INVALID_REQUEST -> Code::INVALID (non-retryable YCQL error code).
